title: Oven Roasted Jamaican Chicken Wrap
description: Rich and dense Jamaican dish featuring wild garlic leaves and wrapped in a pandan leaf, perfect for meal prep. This recipe is anti-inflammatory friendly and uses a deglaze technique for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken with jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, and honey.
Add the chopped wild garlic leaves to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken in a single layer.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Deglaze the baking sheet with a little water to get the browned bits.
Wrap each piece of chicken in a pandan leaf and serve hot.
